paragraphs: Abba Yehudah performed charitable deeds generously, then lost his property. R. Eliezer, R. Yehoshua, and R. Akiva went to collect charity. He sold a field and gave them half. They prayed for him, and he became wealthy: Jerusalem Horayot 3:4:3 (halakhah 7 in Heilprin); see there at length.
